run_chat_game_cfr_experiment: run the chat_game_cfr_example module to build an imitation dataset using CFR on a chat game
build_cfr_solver: build a CFR solver on a cached OpenSpiel game tree and iterate to find an average policy
traverse_game_tree: traverse a game tree and record info state data with observation, probabilities, and action history
construct_imitation_dataset: construct an imitation dataset of observations paired with CFR equilibrium strategies for a chat game domain
eval_vs_any: evaluate an equilibrium policy against a background any policy and compute NashConv and payoffs
